FIELDS.NAME: Precision Engineering & Surveying, Inc.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Precision Engineering & Surveying, Inc. specializes in providing comprehensive engineering and surveying services across a variety of sectors. Our core operations include land surveying, civil engineering design, and project management, focusing on residential, commercial, and infrastructure projects. We utilize state-of-the-art technology and certified, well-maintained equipment to ensure accurate data collection and analysis, minimizing the likelihood of operational errors. Our team of licensed professionals is committed to delivering high-quality services while maintaining strict compliance with all relevant regulations and safety standards. Regular employee training and risk management protocols are integral to our operations, ensuring a commitment to excellence and safety in every project.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in geophysical exploration involving explosives or seismic testing and confirms that it maintains professional liability insurance with coverage limits appropriate to its project scope. Additionally, there is no history of frequent or severe claims related to professional negligence, and the company is not involved in any litigation concerning structural failures, environmental contamination, or third-party injury.
FIELDS.PREVIOUS CARRIER: The Hartford Steam Boiler Inspection and Insurance Company
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On February 14, 2023, a minor data collection incident occurred on a residential surveying project due to a software glitch, resulting in a loss of approximately $2,500 to rectify data discrepancies. The issue was resolved, and measures have been implemented to prevent future occurrences. Status: Closed.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $1,000,000 combined single limit with a $1,000 deductible
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Mon-Fri 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM, Sat 9:00 AM - 1:00 PM
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing installed around the property perimeter and regular patrols by hired security personnel during non-working hours to ensure safety and prevent unauthorized access.
